rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a regional, social, or foreign way of pronouncing a language.

example.english: Your accent is very noticeable when you speak English.
example.traditional: 你講英文嗰陣口音好明顯。
example.jyutping: nei5 gong2 jing1 man4 go2 zan6 hau2 jam1 hou2 ming4 hin2

rows.note: Use this for stress placed on a particular syllable within a word or phrase.

example.english: The accent in this word falls on the second syllable.
example.traditional: 呢個字嘅重音喺第二個音節。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zi6 ge3 cung5 jam1 hai2 dai6 ji6 go3 jam1 zit3

rows.note: Use this for the main emphasis, priority, or focus, as in putting the emphasis on luxury.

example.english: The report puts the accent on cost control.
example.traditional: 份報告將重點放喺控制成本。
example.jyutping: fan6 bou3 gou3 zoeng1 zung6 dim2 fong3 hai2 hung3 zai3 sing4 bun2

rows.note: Use this for a written mark that shows which syllable carries word stress.

example.english: The textbook uses an accent mark to show which syllable should be stressed.
example.traditional: 課本用重音符號標示邊個音節要讀得重啲。
example.jyutping: fo3 bun2 jung6 cung5 jam1 fu4 hou6 biu1 si6 bin1 go3 jam1 zit3 jiu3 duk6 dak1 zung6 di1
